name: Facet
text: Adopt a **single, high-contrast dark theme by default** with a **persistent interactive graph** at the center of the interface. This maximizes visibility and liveliness—dark backgrounds reduce eye strain in low-light settings, while a live graph keeps users oriented and engaged. The trade-off is reduced novelty for users who prefer light themes, but clarity and speed of understanding outweigh that cost.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A single dark theme by default locks out users with light sensitivity—this isn’t a niche edge case, it’s a daily failure for millions. The real risk isn’t red, it’s alienating half the room before they even see the graph.

name: Facet
text:
Adopt a **system-wide dark theme by default** with a **one-click toggle to light mode** in the top-right corner. This keeps the high-contrast benefits for the majority who prefer it—reducing eye strain and keeping the graph lively—while giving light-sensitive users an immediate escape hatch. The trade-off is a tiny bit of interface clutter, but it’s a standard pattern users already recognize, so the clarity and speed of use won’t suffer.

text: Pane: A one-click toggle still fragments the experience—users switch mid-session, breaking flow and clarity. The real risk isn’t light sensitivity; it’s that the default choice still excludes someone, and the toggle adds cognitive load. Settle it with A/B testing: measure retention and satisfaction with dark default vs. system preference, not just preference.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Ship EXCAVA with ambient-light detection auto-switching between dark and light themes by default, plus a one-time theme picker at first launch for users who override the system choice.

Result: A seamless, accessible interface that adapts to user preference and environment without cognitive friction. Owned by Facet.
